title: `Core\Json::decodeAs` formats a path for every list element and collects an issue for every bad one.
text: From the Stage 4 review, not re-run: `decode_positions` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/json.rs:3265-3331`) runs `format!("{path}.{at}")` for every element of a list field, also on success, and appends an issue for each bad element, recursing into nested lists. `decode_each` (`json.rs:2368-2373`) states the policy of stopping at the first bad element, so the two paths disagree, and the message built at `:2493` is O(N · path). Building the path only on failure and stopping at the first issue makes it linear with one issue. Ladder: `json/decode-as.nvs`, a class with an `array<int>` field given N string elements; issues stay at one.
